headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points while Nifty reclaimed 25,000 to end Samvat 2082 on a high note.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: In the last session, Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028.
Nifty 50 reclaimed the key 25,000 mark to close at 25,030.
Indian equities bucked global tech selloffs to post their best week in six years.
Bulls took charge on D-Street as financial and auto indices jumped sharply.
whatHappening: Financial and auto sector stocks spearheaded the market rally during the recent sessions.
Enforcement Directorate is probing crypto platforms CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over illegal foreign transactions.
Delhi High Court ruled that Unity Small Finance Bank cannot sidestep BharatPe's consent.
The Centre mandated stock declarations for rice and paddy to curb rising food prices.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices witnessed a massive rally as Sensex jumped 1,718 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,000.
Financial and auto stocks led the gains, enabling domestic equities to post their best week in six years despite weak global cues.
Markets capped off Samvat 2082 on a strong note prior to the weekend closure.
